facts.L2_tax_id: Resident Registration Number, or a Business Registration Number for your business.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 6–45%, plus 10% local income tax.

facts.L5_data_protection: PIPA applies; penalties up to 10% of revenue from September 2026.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 7 days of receiving goods.
facts.L7_incentives: Simplified VAT under ₩104 million; no VAT payable under ₩48 million.
facts.D1_id_document: Resident registration card, or Alien Registration Card for foreigners.
